mapper.update: UPDATE media_metadata_file SET revision=revision+1,error=NULL WHERE song_id IN(SELECT id FROM media_song WHERE source_id=#{source} AND relative_path=#{path})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_metadata_file(song_id) SELECT s.id FROM media_song s WHERE s.source_id=#{source} AND s.relative_path=#{path} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_metadata_file f WHERE f.song_id=s.id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_metadata_file f JOIN media_song s ON s.id=f.song_id JOIN media_source source ON source.id=s.source_id WHERE s.source_id=#{sourceId} AND (f.synced_revision<f.revision OR COALESCE(f.source_location,'')<>source.location) AND f.error IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.song_id,f.revision,s.source_id FROM media_metadata_file f JOIN media_song s ON s.id=f.song_id JOIN media_source source ON source.id=s.source_id WHERE (f.synced_revision<f.revision OR COALESCE(f.source_location,'')<>source.location OR f.error IS NOT NULL) AND (f.error IS NULL OR f.updated_at<#{retryBefore}) ORDER BY f.revision DESC,COALESCE(f.updated_at,'') LIMIT 250
mapper.update: UPDATE media_metadata_file SET synced_revision=#{revision},result_json=#{result},source_location=#{location},error=#{error},updated_at=#{now} WHERE song_id=#{songId} AND revision=#{revision}
